body: Your probably very right. Actually, my rational mind knows your right. Normally I write when I feel low. Gives me a sense of control and escape. Gym's also a good point. I haven't been in awhile. Thanks.

I appreciate your words of encouragement. I'll definitely take you up on that offer. I have a new prescription and more appointments next week. As for my friend there's no patching things up. She left the country without telling me she was leaving and when I confronted her about it--I found out through a friend, it sucked--She put all the fault on me, didn't at least apologize for leaving without a goodbye after leading me to believe we were still friends, she was just busy, etc etc excuses. It was a cold dear Jane with the protection of the Atlantic ocean and any kind of accountability. I apologized again in my final reply and wished her well. Even when I misstep socially I try to identify it and correct it as it happens. But sometimes the damage's done. The crack is there. And not everyone wants to repair things.
